structure_list.title: Navy base structure list (1965)
structure_list.caption: U.S. Naval Station Kodiak General Development Map, Index of Structures (1965). Each row: building number, map sheet, grid square, use and size. The map sheets 5–23 above share these grid squares. Not placed on the map: the list has no coordinates.

items.title: 1949 topo — Isthmus Bay to Sacramento River
items.caption: Topo map of the Chiniak area, 1949, from Microsoft Terraserver images.
items.verify: Fitted to the Kodiak Island Borough coastline (shoreline match, median 27 m, 67% of shoreline within 50 m). Checked independently: KIB roads (not used in the fit) and the OSM Miller Field runway land on the 1949 road and runway.

items.title: 1949 topo — Pony Point to Sequel Point
items.caption: Same 1949 topo map, zoomed in on Pony Pt. to Sequel (Soquel) Pt.
items.verify: Fitted to the Kodiak Island Borough coastline (shoreline match, median 35 m). Checked independently: the OSM Miller Field runway and KIB Chiniak road (not used in the fit) land on the map's runway and road.

items.title: Puffin Island composite map
items.caption: Made from two originals and a field survey.

items.title: Long Island map
items.caption: Long Island map made from an AutoCAD file: Point Head, Castle Bluff, Deer Point, Garage Area, Headquarters Complex, Burt Point.
items.verify: Fitted to the Kodiak Island Borough coastline (shoreline match, median 21 m, 72% within 50 m). Checked independently: the field-GPS BAT4 and BAT5 points fall on the map's Deer Point and Castle Bluff labels.
